Game Overview

At its heart, Frog Rush is a animal game about survive a frog-fueled apocalypse in Frog Rush. Use Chemical K to spark chain explosions, eliminating mutated amphibians in this strategic-arcade combo. Precision and timing are key as you plan chemical drops to maximize chaotic destruction, conserve resources, and clear levels. Will you outsmart the explosive invasion?
